---
title: "Interactive Explorer — Sleep & Physical Strength"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(scales)

fmt1 <- \(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)

# Load preserved 10,987-participant dataset (unmodified)
df <- read_rds("data/processed/nhanes_sleep_strength.rds")

n_total <- nrow(df)
n_male <- sum(df$sex == "Male")
n_female <- sum(df$sex == "Female")
n_ts_miss <- sum(is.na(df$trouble_sleeping))
n_sd_miss <- sum(is.na(df$sleep_disorder))

init_mean_m <- fmt1(mean(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Male"]))
init_mean_f <- fmt1(mean(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Female"]))
init_med_m  <- fmt1(median(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Male"]))
init_med_f  <- fmt1(median(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Female"]))

gap_m <- mean(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Male" & df$sleep_category == "Long (9+h)"]) -
  mean(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Male" & df$sleep_category == "Recommended (7-8h)"])
gap_f <- mean(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Female" & df$sleep_category == "Long (9+h)"]) -
  mean(df$combined_grip_kg[df$sex == "Female" & df$sleep_category == "Recommended (7-8h)"])

# Compact column encoding for fast browser cross-filtering of all 10,987 rows
explorer_records <- df |>
  transmute(
    a  = as.integer(age),
    ag = as.character(age_group),
    s  = as.character(sex),
    r  = as.character(race_ethnicity),
    sh = as.integer(sleep_hours),
    sc = as.character(sleep_category),
    ts = coalesce(as.character(trouble_sleeping), "Missing"),
    sd = coalesce(as.character(sleep_disorder), "Missing"),
    cg = round(combined_grip_kg, 1),
    mg = round(max_hand_grip_kg, 1),
    w  = round(mec_weight_4yr, 1)
  )

explorer_json <- toJSON(explorer_records, dataframe = "columns", auto_unbox = TRUE)

dep_widget <- plot_ly() |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("function(el) { el.style.display = 'none'; }")
```
